Actor.description:
Identifies the specific participant who authored a `User` or `Assistant`
conversation item, for conversations with more than one distinct actor
on that role (e.g. MSC's end-user/agent distinction, or a Teams channel
thread). Absent when the item's role alone identifies the author.

Serializes as a tagged object (`{"type": "msc_user"}`, `{"type": "teams", ...}`,
etc). Deserialization additionally accepts the bare strings `"End_User"` /
`"Customer_Service_Agent"` for `MscUser` / `MscAgent { name: None }` — MSC's
legacy `/instruction` and `/suggestion` endpoints have sent exactly those two
string values on the wire for years, so reading that shape can't be dropped.
Nothing produces it anymore; it's accepted, not emitted.

OpenAI Responses API `phase: "commentary"` text: an intermediate
preamble emitted before a tool call, distinct from the turn's final
answer. Plain assistant-authored text, not hidden reasoning like
`Thinking`.

A sensitive string (masked in debug output).

- `is_external: true` — the value came from an external source (e.g. user/API input)
  No decryption is needed.
- `is_external: false` — the value is internally managed (e.g. a database default)
  and is stored encrypted. It must be decrypted before use.
